edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before renouncing ownership.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership, the caller controls privilege escalation.
mint requires msg.sender == saleAgent || owner, an untrusted role check.
finishMinting is gated on msg.sender being saleAgent or owner.
withdraw requires msg.sender == owner || devWallet.
setSaleAgent can be reassigned by owner or current sale agent.
Configurator.deploy is onlyOwner and wires the whole privileged system.
mintTokensBatch is onlyOwner yet mints arbitrary amounts.
constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
fallback requires now >= start && now < endSaleDate(), a timestamp dependency.
PreITO fallback enforces the same timestamp window on now.
currentMilestone uses now to pick the milestone index and bonus.
fallback forwards msg.value to the wallet via an external ETH transfer before returning tokens.
withdraw pays the developer fee through an external call before the main payout.
withdraw sends the entire contract balance to the wallet address.
refund performs an external ETH transfer to the caller.
refund sends ETH to the caller-controlled address msg.sender.
processCallback invokes an arbitrary registered callback contract after transfer.
external tokenFallback invocation re-enters the recipient contract.
registered callback contract receives tokenFallback during transfer processing.
mintTokens performs an external call into an owner-settable token contract.
retrieveTokens calls transfer on an arbitrary caller-supplied ERC20 address.
Token.transfer routes the transfer result into processCallback.
Token.transferFrom routes the transfer result into processCallback.
transfer subtracts _value using SafeMath.sub.
transfer adds _value using SafeMath.add.
transferFrom subtracts _value from the source balance and allowance.
transferFrom adds _value to the destination balance.
mint performs totalSupply_.add and balances.add on amounts controlled by the minter.
updateInvested adds the investment value to invested.
mintExtendedTokens computes allTokens with chained mul/div/sub arithmetic.
mintExtendedTokens multiplies supply by percentRate via SafeMath.mul.
mintExtendedTokens divides by percentRate via SafeMath.div.
mintExtendedTokens subtracts summaryTokensPercent via SafeMath.sub.
addMilestone adds the new period to totalPeriod.
removeMilestone subtracts the removed period from totalPeriod.
changeMilestone subtracts the old and adds the new period to totalPeriod.
insertMilestone adds the inserted period to totalPeriod.
clearMilestones resets totalPeriod and mutates the array length.
decreaseApproval subtracts the allowance with SafeMath.sub.
increaseApproval adds to the allowance with SafeMath.add.
ITO.calculateTokens multiplies _invested by price.
PreITO.calculateTokens multiplies _invested by price.
endSaleDate adds period * 1 days to start with SafeMath.add.
